title: A flow-cytometry-based assay to assess granule exocytosis and GZB delivery by human CD8 T cells and NK cells
protocol: Label L1210-FAS- cell line with CellTrace™ Far Red.
Facilitate the analysis by discriminating CTFR+ target cells from CTFR- effector cells.
Identify degranulation events in effector T cells through surface staining of CD8 and CD107a mAbs.
Prepare CellTrace™ Far Red solution by diluting the 10 μM stock solution.
Dilute 2.5 μL of the 10 μM CTFR stock with 247.5 μL of PBS (without Ca++/Mg++) to achieve a final concentration of 0.1 μM.
Label target cells, such as L1210 or K562, with an optimized working concentration of CellTrace™ Far Red.
Optimize the CTFR concentration for each cell line by assessing different concentrations using flow cytometry.
Select the optimal CTFR concentration that provides at least a 1 Log difference in fluorescence intensity between unstained cells and CTFR+ labeled cells.
Mix the L1210-FAS- cell line up and down with a 10 mL pipette.
Take an aliquot to measure cell count and viability.
Harvest a volume corresponding to 5–7 × 10^6 targets from the flask into 15 mL tubes.
Pellet the cell suspension by centrifugation at 526 g for 6 min at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet and wash by addition of 10 mL of PBS (without Ca++/Mg++).
Centrifuge the cells at 526 g for 6 min at 20°C.
Repeat the washing step twice.
Aspirate and discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet by flicking the tube with a finger.
Add 250 μl of CTFR 0.1 μM working solution to L1210-FAS- cells at a concentration of 20 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Resuspend the cells by pipetting up and down with a 1 ml tip.
Incubate the cell suspension in a water bath at 37°C for 8 min, mixing every 2–3 min.
Quench the reaction by adding cold filtered Fetal Bovine Serum (1:1 volume) to the cell suspension, vortex and place on ice for 5 min.
Wash cells by adding 10 ml of PBS without Ca++/Mg++ and centrifuge at 526 g for 6 min at 4°C.
Repeat washing step twice.
Prepare 100 mL of 1× HEPES saline buffer by diluting 10× HEPES saline buffer (0.1 M HEPES, 1.5 M NaCl, pH 7.5) with diH2O.
Prepare 50 mL of 1× HEPES saline buffer containing 1% bovine serum albumin (BSA).
Warm the vial of Biotin-X-NHS for 5 minutes at room temperature before use.
Weigh 1.11 mg of Biotin-X-NHS and dissolve in 1 mL of 1× HEPES saline buffer to prepare a 2 mM solution.
Dilute the 2 mM Biotin-X-NHS solution 1:10 with 1× HEPES saline buffer to obtain a final concentration of 0.2 mM.
Thaw Streptavidin (2 mg/mL stock) and dilute to a working concentration of 20 μg/mL in HEPES + 1% BSA saline buffer.
Resuspend the cell pellet of CTFR+ L1210-FAS- cells with 2 mL of HEPES saline buffer.
Count and check viability as described in section isolation of human CD8 T cells from peripheral blood.
Place the CTFR+ L1210-FAS- cells (5 × 10^6 cells) into a 15 mL tube.
Add 8 mL of HEPES saline buffer to the cells.
Centrifuge at 526 × g for 6 min at 4°C.
Repeat the washing step once more.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 1 mL of 0.2 mM Biotin-X-NHS to reach a cell concentration of 5 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Vortex and place the tube on ice for 30 min.
Wash the cells once with HEPES saline buffer containing 1% BSA by centrifugation at 526 × g for 6 min at 4°C.
Resuspend cell pellet with 0.5 mL of 20 μg/mL streptavidin (SA) to a cell concentration of 10 × 10^6 cells/mL and transfer to a new tube.
Incubate the tube at room temperature (20°C–25°C) for 30 min.
Wash the cells with HEPES saline buffer containing 1% BSA by centrifugation at 526 × g for 6 min at 20°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of X-VIVO™ 15 media.
Count the cells and adjust to 5 × 10^6 cells/mL in X-VIVO™ 15 media.
Resuspend CD8 effector T cells at a concentration of 5 × 10^6 cells/mL in X-VIVOTM 15 media.
Resuspend B-SA-CTFR+L1210FAS- target cells at a concentration of 5 × 10^6 cells/mL in X-VIVOTM 15 media.
Dilute 1 μL of NFL1 in 9 μL of X-VIVOTM 15 media to create a working solution.
Add 3.3 μL of the NFL1 working solution to 1 mL of each cell suspension for a final dilution of 1:3000.
Incubate both cell suspensions for 15 minutes at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Wash cells twice with X-VIVOTM 15 media by centrifugation at 526 × g for 6 minutes at 20°C.
Resuspend the washed CD8 effector T cells in X-VIVOTM 15 media.
Count viable CD8 effector T cells and B-SA-CTFR+L1210FAS- target cells.
Adjust B-SA-CTFR+L1210FAS- Target cells to a concentration of 1.6 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Adjust effector CD8 T cells to a concentration of 43.2 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Plate 25 μL of target cells per well.
Plate 25 μL of effector cells per well.
Ensure the E:T ratio is optimized for each type of effectors, with an example E:T ratio of 27:1 using human CD8 T cells.
Do not exceed a total cell number of 1.5 × 10^6 cells per condition in V-bottom 96 well plates.
For higher cell numbers, perform the incubation in 15 mL conical tubes to avoid unspecific cell death.
Plate targets cells at a concentration of 5 × 10^4 cells per 96 well plate.
Ensure no less than 2.5 × 10^4 cells are plated per 96 well plate for optimal flow cytometry analysis.
Use freshly isolated or thawed and rested overnight PBMCs for ex-vivo NK cell cytotoxicity assays.
Culture K562 cells at a ratio of 60:1 or 10:1 with PBMCs for the assay.
Cultivate CTFR-labeled K562 cells alone in the presence of GZB substrate as negative control for GZB activity.
Mix CTFR+ L1210-FAS- with PBMCs to serve as a negative control for GZB delivery by NK cells.
Plate effector and target cells into V-bottom 96 well plates.
Centrifuge the plate at 189 × g for 3 min at 20°C.
Add 50 μL media to CD8 T cells + GranToxiLux and B-SA-CTFR+L1210FAS- + GranToxiLux separately.
Add 50 μL X-VivoTM 15 to the target and effector alone culture conditions.
Place the plate in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 45 min.
Add 10 μL of a cocktail of mAbs containing CD8 and CD107a mAbs slowly.
Centrifuge the plate at 189 × g for 30 s at 20°C to mix the mAbs and cells or use a modified pipette tip to mix gently up and down.
Incubate in the incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2 for an additional 15 min.
Prepare FACS tubes containing 100 μL of FC staining buffer.
Resuspend the compensation beads vial by vortexing and add one drop into the FACS tubes.
Add 5 μL of FITC-labeled anti-CD3 mAb to the compensation tube.
Add 5 μL of anti-CD8 BUV395 to the compensation tube.
Add 5 μL of anti-CD107a APC-H7 mAb to the compensation tube.
Incubate the compensation beads for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash the compensation beads once with 2 mL of FC staining buffer by centrifugation at 526 × g for 6 min at 4°C.
Aspirate or decant the supernatant and resuspend the beads in 100 μL.
Keep the compensation beads on ice and protected from light until setting up compensation.
Resuspend cells in 96-well plates gently with a 200 μL pipette and transfer into FACS tubes.
Wash cells once by adding 2 mL of cool (4°C) FC staining buffer to each well.
Centrifuge the FACS tubes at 526 × g for 6 min at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 200 μL of cool FC staining buffer.
Keep the cell suspension on ice and acquire using a flow cytometer.
Set up the flow cytometer in advance before acquisition of the cells.
Keep FACS tubes of the samples on ice all the time and protected from light until acquisition.
Acquire cell data immediately, no more than 1 hour after preparation to avoid losing signal of granzyme B activity.
Identify CTFR+ cells as target cells based on CTFR+ expression.
Evaluate the delivery and activity of GZB inside target cells by measuring CTFR+substrate+(GrantoxiLux) in CTFR+ gate.
Measure degranulation of CD8+ T cells by surface expression of CD107a.
